applicability.reason: The generated profile uses separate frontend and backend runtimes and can multiply build, hosting, API, and observability costs.

summary: Generated projects must identify independent runtime budgets, request and build limits, quotas, monitoring, degradation, ownership, and kill switches without claiming a universal cost model.

checks.notes: Harness execution and archive budgets are bounded; downstream runtime costs remain project-specific.

findings.title: Downstream cost evidence is project-specific
findings.required_action: Document quotas, worst-case exposure, alerts, degradation, and a kill switch before releasing a generated project with variable-cost services.

evidence.summary: Bounded local execution and explicit downstream cost-condition evidence.

approval.reason: No paid or production service is used by the local candidate build.

handoff: Quantify and approve cost exposure separately for each generated deployment.
